social.text: What I think happened is an attempt at fixing some improperly assigned vertex groups applied an effect similar to a negative scale to some meshes without actually applying a negative scale. This made everything look okay but caused render inside out in Godot. I figured it out by adding a cube to one of the problem meshes. That cube was also inside out which isn't normal. Since nothing else was wrong I tried unassigning the skeleton and that, finally, fixed it # gamedev # blender # robotshooter

social.text: Negative space 🎬 It’s the part of the frame not occupied by your subject, and it’s a deliberate choice, not wasted room. A small figure in a big empty frame can say isolation or scale. Tight, cramped framing can say tension. Off-center placement can leave the shot feeling unsettled. Don’t always fill the frame. Sometimes the empty space is part of the story. # Filmmaking # Cinematography # NegativeSpace # Composition # VisualStorytelling
